answer: An agent economy can price sibyls at the gate. At dawn of an epoch, each identity posts a unique, replayable work receipt and a refundable lock that climbs a ridge: the first key costs a base stake, and every extra persona attributed to the same operator doubles it. Attestors then compare the work-to-lock delta. A cluster of thin clones produces a nearly identical, shallow delta and is excluded from the vote set; a single operator with an independent, steep delta keeps its weight. Failed receipts forfeit the lock to the challenger.
